headline: Xiaomi & DeepSeek dominate; Tencent hits all-time high
summary: Xiaomi and DeepSeek are trading blows at the top, each holding roughly 19.9% and 19.7% of token share respectively. Tencent's hy3-20260706 just set an all-time record at 9.3%, while Anthropic's newly-launched claude-opus-5 also hit its peak. Five models entered the rankings today, including OpenAI's gpt-5.5 and gpt-5.4-mini, while five others dropped out.
highlights: Tencent/hy3-20260706 reaches 9.3% token share—an all-time high
Xiaomi and DeepSeek locked in a near-tie at the top (19.9% vs 19.7%)
Anthropic's claude-opus-5-20260723 debuts at rank 15 with 1.3% share, already an all-time peak
Perplexity's pplx-embed-v1-0.6B vaults 20 ranks in one day to #29
Five new entrants today; five models fell out of the top 51
Market concentration (HHI) up 2.2 points over 30 days—top players pulling further ahead
